title: S corporation income and basis — Sable Inc.
instructions: Sable Inc. is a calendar-year S corporation with no accumulated E&P, owned 50% by Ana Ruiz. Classify Sable's items and compute the amounts for Ana.

exhibits.title: Sable Inc. — 2025
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Gross receipts | 900,000 |
| Cost of goods sold | 400,000 |
| Salaries, including $160,000 of reasonable wages to the shareholders | 300,000 |
| MACRS depreciation | 50,000 |
| §179 expense | 20,000 |
| Charitable contributions | 10,000 |
| Long-term capital gain | 16,000 |
| Tax-exempt interest | 4,000 |

Ana's stock basis at January 1, 2025: **$30,000**. Sable distributed **$40,000** cash to Ana in 2025. Ana has made no loans to Sable.

rows.label: Salaries to shareholder-employees
rows.explanation: Reasonable compensation is deducted in computing ordinary business income.

rows.label: §179 expense
rows.explanation: §179 is separately stated and limited at the shareholder level.

rows.label: Tax-exempt interest
rows.explanation: Tax-exempt income is separately stated; it increases basis.

rows.label: Ana's share of ordinary business income
Taxable portion of Ana's distribution
rows.explanation: The distribution (40,000) doesn't exceed her basis after income increases, so **0** is taxable.
